cohort: 302 very preterm infants (gestational age <32 weeks) admitted to Qinghai Red Cross Hospital from January 1, 2018 to December 31, 2020
finding: Short-term prognosis of very preterm infants of ethnic minorities was similar to that of Han nationality infants, with no excess risk of death, death or major morbidity, death despite active treatment, or death or major morbidity despite active treatment observed in ethnic minorities.
mod_finding: A lower proportion of cesarean sections was observed in ethnic minority mothers compared to Han mothers (9.1% vs. 17.6%, p < .05).
